notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Revolutionist each turn.
description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
